title: What if the Sun came closer to Earth?
description:
POV: you're lying on a summer beach when Earth starts falling toward the Sun. ☀️🔥

At half the distance the Sun looks twice as wide. At a quarter, sunlight is 16 times stronger and towels, parasols and palm trees catch fire.

Would you run or stay? 👇

New what-ifs every week on IfScape3D.
Animated with code, AI voice.
